title: Demo Hotel (sample profile)
subtitle: Room availability, rates and booking requests

options.title: Availability and price
options.description: See what is free for your dates and party size, with the total price.
options.example: Do you have anything free this weekend for 2 guests?

options.title: Request the booking
options.description: Send a booking request. The business confirms it; nothing is held or charged here.
options.example: Please request the first option for me

options.title: Ask a question
options.description: Answers from the business's own information: rooms, amenities, policies and booking enquiries.
options.example: Do you have a room for two nights next weekend?

options.title: Booking status
options.description: Check a booking request with its reference.
options.example: What's the status of my booking request?

options.title: Contact the business
options.description: Phone, email, website and opening hours.
options.example: How do I contact the business?
